blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We present MGhana-ST, a speech translation dataset for four low-resource Ghanaian language varieties: Ga, Twi (Akuapem and Asante), Ewe, and Fante. MGhana-ST is an ongoing annotation effort; the experiments reported here use a fixed subset of approximately 16.1 hours of paired speech and English translation data. The audio is curated from two existing Ghanaian speech resources. The English translations in MGhana-ST are produced directly from the audio by 37 native-speaker annotators, rather than derived from source-language transcriptions as in the upstream resources, and are accompanied by verbal and non-verbal event annotations. Using Whisper-small as a backbone, we examine monolingual and multilingual training under severe data scarcity, reporting all baseline results as means over three training seeds. We find that flat multilingual training benefits no variety in this regime. Ga and Twi are unchanged within seed variance ( + 0.51 +0.51 and + 0.06 +0.06 BLEU against monolingual standard deviations of 1.63 1.63 and 2.20 2.20 ), while Ewe declines by 6.99 6.99 BLEU and Fante by 5.11 5.11 . The two varieties that degrade are Ewe, which is both linguistically distinct and drawn from a different source corpus, and Fante, the least-resourced variety. We further compare empirical cross-lingual transfer with typology-based similarity and find that, in this four-language setting, transfer BLEU identifies which language pairs interact more closely than URIEL similarity does, although neither measure predicts which varieties benefit from joint training. We also report a methodological finding of independent interest. An earlier single-run version of this analysis found positive transfer for three of four varieties; that result did not survive replication across seeds. For Ga and Twi, monolingual baselines trained on roughly 1.6 to 6.2 hours of audio have seed standard deviations of 1.63 1.63 and 2.20 2.20 BLEU, roughly five and thirty times those of the corresponding multilingual models ( 0.35 0.35 and 0.07 0.07 ). When the monolingual condition is the noisier one, a single-run comparison can show apparent transfer of this size from seed variation alone. We release MGhana-ST to support future research on African language speech technologies and low-resource multilingual speech translation.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multilingual speech models have significantly expanded the scope of automatic speech recognition and speech translation. Whisper ( Radford et al., 2023 ) , trained on 680,000 hours of audio across 99 languages, achieves strong performance on a range of speech benchmarks, while the Massively Multilingual Speech project ( Pratap et al., 2024 ) extends multilingual speech modelling to more than 1,100 languages. However, scaling multilingual training also introduces a central tension: parameter sharing across languages can improve performance through positive transfer, but it can also degrade performance through negative transfer when jointly trained languages are insufficiently compatible ( Wang et al., 2020 ; Arivazhagan et al., 2019 ) . This trade-off is especially consequential in low-resource settings, where the amount of supervised data is too limited to absorb poorly matched multilingual signals.
blocks.zh: 多语种语音模式显著扩大了语音自动识别和语音翻译的范围. Whisper(Radford et al., 2023年),经过68万小时的99种语言的音频培训,在一系列语音基准上取得了强劲的成绩,而Massively Multiple Speech Project(Pratap et al., 2024年)则将多语种语音建模扩展到1100多种语言. 然而,推广多语种培训也带来了一个核心的矛盾:不同语言的参数共享可以通过正向转移来提高性能,但当联合培训的语言不够兼容时,也可以通过负向转移来降低性能(Wang等人,2020年;Arivazhagan等人,2019年). 这种取舍在资源匮乏的情况下尤为严重,因为受监督的数据数量有限,无法吸收不匹配的多语种信号。

blocks.en: Speech translation (ST) enables direct translation from speech in a source language to text in a target language without requiring an intermediate automatic speech recognition (ASR) step ( Bérard et al., 2016 ; Duong et al., 2016 ) . In our setting, reliable ASR support for Ga, Twi, Ewe, and Fante remains limited, making end-to-end speech translation a practical modelling choice. The subset used in our experiments comprises about 16.1 hours of labelled speech-translation data across the four varieties, a regime in which model design and multilingual training strategy can materially affect final system quality.
blocks.zh: 语音翻译(ST)可以直接从源语言的语音翻译到目标语言的文本,而不需要中间自动语音识别(ASR)步骤(Bérard等人,2016年;Duong等人,2016年). 在我们的环境下,对Ga,Twi,Ewe,和Fante的可靠ASR支持仍然有限,使得端到端的语音翻译成为实用的建模选择. 我们实验中使用的子集包括大约16.1小时的标注在四个品种上的语音翻译数据,在这个制度中,模型设计和多语种培训战略可以对最后系统质量产生实质影响。

blocks.en: The Ghanaian languages considered here provide a useful testbed for studying multilingual transfer under partial linguistic relatedness. Twi (in its Akuapem and Asante varieties) and Fante belong to the Akan branch and are more closely related to one another than either is to Ga or Ewe (see the language family column in Table 1 ). Relatedness within this set is uneven: some language pairs are more likely to benefit from multilingual transfer, while others may introduce cross-language interference. These properties make the setting well-suited to studying when multilingual speech translation helps, when it hurts, and whether task-specific transfer signals are more informative than typological similarity measures for designing multilingual training configurations.
blocks.zh: 这里考虑的加纳语为在部分语言相关性下研究多语种传承提供了有用的试验台. Twi(在它的Akuapem和Asante品种中)和Fante属于Akan分支,彼此的关系比Ga或Ewe更密切(见表1的语言家族专栏). 本集中的关联性不均匀:一些语言对称更可能受益于多语种的转移,而另一些则可能引入跨语言干扰. 这些属性使得设置非常适合当多语种语音翻译帮助,伤害时,以及任务特定的传输信号是否比设计多语种培训配置的类型相似度措施更具有信息性进行学习.

blocks.en: Beyond introducing MGhana-ST as a new resource for low-resource Ghanaian speech translation, we use the dataset as a controlled benchmark for analysing multilingual training under severe data scarcity. We distinguish between the dataset itself, which is intended as a reusable community resource, and the empirical observations obtained from our experimental study. The latter should be interpreted as evidence from the modelling choices considered here rather than as intrinsic properties of the dataset.
blocks.zh: 除了将MGhana-ST作为低资源加纳语音翻译的新资源外,我们还使用数据集作为在数据严重短缺的情况下分析多语种培训的控制基准。 我们区分了作为可重复使用的社区资源的数据集本身和从我们的实验研究中获得的经验观测结果。 后者应解释为此处考虑的建模选择的证据,而不是数据集的内在性质。

blocks.en: Our experiments yield four main observations. First, flat multilingual training benefits no variety at this data scale: Ga and Twi are unchanged within seed variance, while Ewe and Fante both degrade substantially. Second, the varieties that degrade share identifiable characteristics: Ewe is the only Gbe variety and is also drawn from a different source corpus, while Fante is the least-resourced variety (1.62h). These observations are consistent with the possibility that joint training reallocates limited capacity toward better-represented varieties, although our experiments do not isolate this mechanism. Third, empirically measured cross-lingual transfer BLEU identifies which language pairs interact more closely than URIEL typological similarity does within our four-language setting, but it does not predict which varieties benefit under joint training. Fourth, and methodologically, monolingual baselines at this scale carry seed standard deviations of up to 2.20 2.20 BLEU, comparable to the single-run gains of + 1.68 +1.68 to + 2.95 +2.95 BLEU that our own earlier analysis reported; single-run comparisons are therefore not adequate in this regime.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验产生了四大观测结果。 第一,统一多语种培训在这个数据尺度上没有任何好处: Ga和Twi在种子差异内没有变化,而Ewe和Fante都大量退化。 第二,降解的品种具有可识别的特点: Ewe是唯一的Gbe品种,也来源于不同的源体,而Fante是资源最少的品种(1.62h). 这些观察与联合培训将有限的能力重新分配给代表性更好的品种的可能性是一致的,尽管我们的实验并不孤立这种机制。 第三,经经验测量的跨语言转移BLEU确定哪些语言对子在四种语言环境中的互动比URIEL类型相似性更紧密,但它无法预测哪些品种在联合培训下受益。 第四,从方法上讲,这一尺度的单一语言基线的种子标准差最高为2.202.20BLEU,可与我们自己先前分析报告的单运行增益1.68+1.68++2.95+2.95BLEU相比较;因此,单运行比较在此制度中是不够的。

blocks.en: Our contributions comprise two distinct parts: a new dataset resource and an empirical study conducted on it. We keep these separate throughout, and readers interested only in the resource may read Section 3 in isolation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Large-scale multilingual speech models such as Whisper ( Radford et al., 2023 ) , MMS ( Pratap et al., 2024 ) , and mSLAM ( Bapna et al., 2022 ) establish broad multilingual capability across many languages and tasks. More recent work, including SpeechMatrix ( Duquenne et al., 2023 ) and SeamlessM4T ( Barrault et al., 2023 ) , extends multilingual speech translation to a large number of languages within unified models. However, these systems primarily focus on scaling capabilities across many languages rather than investigating the specific dynamics of positive and negative transfer within small sets of partially related varieties at severe data scarcity.
blocks.zh: 大型多语种语音模型,如Whisper(Radford等人,2023年),MMS. (Pratap等人,2024年),mSLAM(Bapna等人,2022年)在多种语言和任务中建立了广泛的多语言能力. 最近的工作,包括SpeechMatrix(Duquenne等人,2023年)和SeamlessM4T(Barrault等人,2023年),将多语种语音翻译扩展到统一模式下的大量语言. 然而,这些系统主要侧重于在许多语言中推广能力,而不是在数据严重短缺的情况下,调查少数部分相关的品种中正负转移的具体动态。

blocks.en: Speech resources covering African languages have expanded in recent years, including massively multilingual benchmarks such as FLEURS ( Conneau et al., 2023 ) , accented-speech recognition corpora such as AfriSpeech-200 ( Olatunji et al., 2023 ) , and speech synthesis corpora such as BibleTTS ( Meyer et al., 2022 ) . For Ghanaian languages specifically, UGSpeechData ( Wiafe et al., 2025 ) and the Financial Inclusion Speech Dataset ( Asamoah Owusu et al., 2022 ) provide transcribed speech. Most of these resources were designed primarily for ASR or speech synthesis rather than end-to-end speech translation. MGhana-ST addresses this gap by providing an audio-grounded speech translation dataset for four Ghanaian language varieties and an analysis of multilingual training under severe data scarcity. Our positioning is complementary: while large-scale systems demonstrate broad capability, this work examines the fine-grained transfer dynamics that those aggregate evaluations do not reveal, using typology-based similarity (URIEL) and empirical transfer BLEU as alternative lenses on language relatedness.
blocks.zh: 涵盖非洲语言的语音资源近年来有所扩大,包括大量多语种基准,如FLEURS(Conneau et al., 2023),重音-语音识别corpora(AfriSpeech-200)(Olatunji et al., 2023),以及语言合成corpora(BibleTTS)等(Meyer et al., 2022). 具体针对加纳语,UGSpeechData(Wiafe等人,2025年)和金融包容性演讲数据集(Asamoah Owusu等人,2022年)提供转写语音. 这些资源大多主要用于ASR或语音合成,而不是端到端的语音翻译. MGhana-ST为加纳四种语言提供音频语音翻译数据集,并在数据严重短缺的情况下分析多语种培训,以此弥补这一差距。 我们的定位是互补的:虽然大规模系统显示出广泛的能力,但这项工作审查的是这些总体评价没有揭示的精细的转移动态,利用基于类型相似性(URIEL)和经验转移BLEU作为语言相关性的替代透镜。

blocks.en: 3 The MGhana-ST Dataset
blocks.zh: 3 MGrana-ST数据集

blocks.en: MGhana-ST is a curated dataset of short speech clips in Ghanaian languages paired with English translations and annotations for non-verbal events such as laughter, applause, and background noise. It is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/adwumatech-ai/mghana-st ( Acquaye et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.en: 3.1 Defining the Experimental Subset
blocks.zh: 3.1 界定实验子集

blocks.en: MGhana-ST is an incremental project: annotation is ongoing, and further audio is being processed for inclusion. The experimental subset is the fixed portion of the data used for every result reported in this paper, summarised in Table 1 ; it comprises approximately 16.1 hours across the four varieties. The public release is the annotated data available at the repository above.

We release a manifest at splits/manifest.json in the dataset repository, listing the audio_id , start_ms , and end_ms of every segment assigned to train, validation, and test. blocks.en: Of the 90,583 annotated segments across the four varieties, 11,445 (12.6%) reference audio files that were not present locally and therefore never entered preprocessing. Their distribution is highly uneven across varieties: 39.9% of Ewe segments and 30.4% of Fante segments, against 0.03% for Twi and none for Ga (Table 7 , Appendix B ). We have not determined whether these files are absent from the upstream distributions or absent only from our copy, nor whether their absence is systematic. The Ewe and Fante portions of the experimental subset should therefore be understood as samples of their annotated material whose selection we do not fully characterise.
blocks.zh: 在四个品种的90,583个注释片段中,有11,445个(12.6%)参考音频文件没有在本地出现,因此从未输入预处理. 其分布在品种中极不平衡:Ewe部分占39.9%,Fante部分占30.4%,Twi部分占0.03%,Ga部分无(附录B表7)。 我们尚未确定这些档案是否没有出现在上游的分发中,或只是没有我们的副本,也没有确定这些档案是否系统。 因此,实验子集的Ewe和Fante部分应当被理解为它们附加说明的材料的样本,我们对这些材料的选择并不完全定性。

blocks.en: 3.2 Sources
blocks.zh: 3.2 来源

blocks.en: MGhana-ST aggregates audio from two existing Ghanaian speech resources. Ewe samples were drawn from the transcribed portion of UGSpeechData ( Wiafe et al., 2025 ) , a multilingual Ghanaian speech dataset covering Akan, Ewe, and other languages. The remainder was drawn from the Financial Inclusion Speech Dataset ( Asamoah Owusu et al., 2022 ) , which covers Akuapem Twi, Asante Twi, Fante, and Ga and leans heavily on the financial technology domain.
blocks.zh: MGrana-ST汇总了来自加纳现有两种语音资源的音频. Ewe样本来自UGSpeechData(Wiafe等人,2025年)的转录部分,这是一个涵盖Akan、Ewe和其他语言的多语种加纳语语音数据集。 其余数据来自金融普惠演讲数据集(Asamoah Owusu等人,2022年),涵盖Akuapem Twi、Asante Twi、Fante和Ga,并大量依赖金融技术领域。

blocks.en: Corpus provenance is not evenly distributed across language varieties: all Ewe data is drawn from UGSpeechData, whereas Ga, Twi, and Fante are drawn entirely from the Financial Inclusion Speech Dataset. Because the two corpora differ systematically in domain, recording channel, speaking style, and utterance duration, Ewe differs from the other three varieties along these dimensions as well as linguistically. We return to the implications of this in Section 5 and the Limitations.
blocks.zh: 公司出处在语言品种之间分布不均:Ewe的所有数据来自UGSpeechData,而Ga、Twi和Fante则完全来自金融普惠演讲数据集。 由于两个蝎子在域,录音通道,说话风格,和语音持续时间等方面有系统差异,因此Ewe与这些维度和语言学上的其他三个品种不同. 我们回到第5节和限制所涉及的问题。

blocks.en: The source audio is reused from the two corpora above. The annotation layer is not. MGhana-ST provides translations produced by native speakers listening to the audio directly, rather than translations of written transcriptions as in the upstream resources. Annotators additionally tagged verbal and non-verbal events (laughter, applause, background noise), which have no counterpart upstream.
blocks.zh: 源音频从上面的两个蝎子重复使用. 注释层不是。 MGhana-ST提供当地人直接聆听录音的翻译,而不是上游资源中的书面记录的翻译。 报章人员还贴上了口头和非口头的标签(笑声、掌声、背景噪音),而上游没有对应的。

blocks.en: 3.3 Languages and Coverage
blocks.zh: 3.3 语言和覆盖范围

blocks.en: The experimental subset covers four Ghanaian language varieties: Twi, Ewe, Ga, and Fante. Table 1 reports its train, validation, and test durations per variety. Twi and Fante belong to the Akan branch and are closely related, whereas Ga (Ga-Dangme) and Ewe (Gbe) are more distant from the Akan varieties and from each other.
blocks.zh: 该实验子集包含四个加纳语品种:Twi,Ewe,Ga,和Fante. 表1按品种报告其列车、验证和试验期限。 Twi和Fante属于Akan分支,关系密切,而Ga(Ga-Dangme)和Ewe(Gbe)则与Akan品种和彼此较远.

blocks.en: Splits are constructed at the audio-file level: all segments originating from a single recording are assigned to exactly one of train, validation, or test, so no audio used for training appears in validation or test.
blocks.zh: 拆分在音频文件级别上构建:所有源自单一记录的片段被分配到准确的列车,验证,或测试中,因此在验证或测试中没有出现用于培训的音频.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports per-language utterance counts and durations. Utterances are short: mean duration is 1.33 s for Fante, 1.68 s for Ga, and 1.90 s for Twi. Ewe, drawn from image-description recordings, averages 3.31 s. English reference diversity differs sharply across varieties (Table 3 ): 38.4% of Fante test references repeat another reference, against only 1.5% for Ewe. MGhana-ST should therefore be understood as a word- and phrase-level speech translation resource for three of its four varieties, and a mixed phrase- and sentence-level resource for Ewe.

Ewe references are almost entirely unique, whereas over a third of Fante references are repeated.

blocks.en: 3.4 Annotation and Quality Assurance
blocks.zh: 3.4 注释和质量保证

blocks.en: All English translations and non-verbal event tags were produced by 37 annotators, each a native speaker of the language they annotated. All annotators were employed and paid by AdwumaTech AI and gave informed consent for their translations and annotations to be released. Quality assurance operated at three levels: redundant annotation (a subset of clips received multiple independent translations; 0.3–4.2% of test utterances per variety, Table 3 ), guided native-speaker annotation (teams working from written guidelines covering event annotation and idiomatic expression handling), and two-round independent verification by more experienced annotators. As an independent check on annotation hygiene, we audited every bracketed event tag in the corpus. Of 56,117 translations containing an event tag, 36 (0.06%) are malformed, with the remaining 99.94% conforming exactly to the documented convention.
blocks.zh: 所有英文译文和非语言活动标记都由37名注音员制作,每名注音员都是当地人。 所有注释员都受雇于AdwumaTech AI并支付工资,并知情同意公布他们的翻译和说明。 质量保证在三个层面运作:冗余注释(一组剪辑收到多个独立译文;每类测试语数的0.3-4.2%,表3);指导本土语言注释(小组根据书面准则开展工作,涉及事件注释和平庸表达处理);以及由经验丰富的注释者进行两轮独立核查。 作为对注解卫生的独立检查, 我们审核了所有 括号内的事件标记 在诉讼。 在56 117份带有事件标记的译文中,36份(0.06%)格式不正确,其余的99.94%完全符合有文件记载的公约。

blocks.en: 3.5 Intended Use and Limitations
blocks.zh: 3.5 预期用途和限制

blocks.en: MGhana-ST is intended to support research on speech recognition, speech translation, and speech representation learning for low-resource Ghanaian languages. It is not designed for forensic speaker identification or sensitive demographic inference. In addition, the short duration of many utterances limits the extent to which long-range speaker characteristics can be captured.
blocks.zh: MGhana-ST旨在支持关于低资源加纳语语音识别、语音翻译和语音代表学习的研究。 它的设计不是为了鉴定说法者或敏感的人口推断。 此外,许多话语的短时间限制了能够捕捉长距离扬声器特性的程度.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Our task is speech-to-English translation. We use the encoder of Whisper-small ( Radford et al., 2023 ) (244M parameters in the full model) as the speech backbone. Input speech is converted to 80-channel log-Mel spectrograms and passed through the 12-layer Whisper-small encoder; the resulting 768-dimensional states are linearly projected to d model = 256 d_{\text{model}}=256 and consumed by a custom 4-layer Transformer decoder with 8 attention heads, trained from scratch, which autoregressively produces English text.
blocks.zh: 我们的任务是从语音到英语的翻译。 我们使用Whisper-small(Radford等人,2023年)的编码器(完整模型中的244M参数)作为语音主干. 输入式语音转换为80通道的log-Mel光谱,并经过12层的Whisper-小编码器;产生的768维态线性预测为d模型=256 d_{\text{model}}=256,被定制的4层变形器解码器消耗,8个注意力头,从零开始训练,自动递归生成英文文本.

blocks.en: To adapt the encoder in the low-resource regime, we freeze its lower layers and fine-tune only the top n n layers, with n n chosen by a preliminary sweep on Ga (Appendix A ). The decoder is trained from random initialisation in all configurations.
blocks.zh: 为了在低资源体系中适应编码器,我们冻结其下层,并且只微调顶端nn层,n通过对Ga(Appendix A )的初步扫描选择. 解码器从所有配置的随机初始化中训练出来.

The monolingual (M1) and multilingual baseline (M2) configurations use α = 0 \alpha=0 , so they optimise the translation loss alone; M4 sets α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 . M3 instead applies Domain-Adversarial Training (DANN) with a gradient-reversal layer and λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 ; its domain-classification term is not represented by Eq. 1 . Auxiliary objective variants (M3 and M4) are reported in Appendix D .

blocks.en: 4.1 Reproducibility and Seed Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1 可复制性和种子议定书

blocks.en: Two distinct random seeds govern our experiments.
blocks.zh: 两个明显的随机种子 指导我们的实验。

blocks.en: The split seed controls the audio-level assignment of recordings to train, validation, and test. It is fixed at 42 for every experiment in this paper. All runs therefore share a single, identical data partition, which is published as the manifest described in Section 3.1 .
blocks.zh: 分裂种子控制录音的音频级分配,用于训练,验证,测试. 它被固定在42 对于本文的每一个实验。 因此,所有运行都共享一个单一、相同的数据分区,该分区作为第3.1节所述清单公布。

blocks.en: The training seed controls parameter initialisation, batch ordering, and dropout. Where we report means and standard deviations, they are computed over training seeds { 1 , 2 , 3 } \{1,2,3\} with the split held fixed. The variance we report is thus training variance under a fixed partition.
blocks.zh: 培训种子控制参数初始化、批量订购和辍学。 我们报告的方法和标准偏差,是用训练种子 {1,2,3}计算出来的。 因此,我们报告的差异是固定分区下的培训差异。

blocks.en: Runs are not bitwise deterministic ( deterministic: false ), so exact per-run reproduction is not guaranteed even at a fixed seed; the reported means and standard deviations are the reproducible quantities.
blocks.zh: 运行不是比特判断性(决定性:假),所以即使是在固定种子中,精确的每运行的繁殖也不能保证;报告的手段和标准偏差是可复制的数量.

blocks.en: The M1 and M2 configurations are run at three seeds and reported as mean ± \pm sample standard deviation. The auxiliary conditioning experiments and the cross-lingual transfer matrix are single-run at training seed 42 and are reported as such (Appendices C and D ). We do not compute deltas between multi-seed and single-run configurations, as this would confound treatment effects with the particular seed draw.
blocks.zh: M1和M2配置在3个种子中运行,并报告为平均值±\pm样本标准偏差. 辅助调理实验和跨语言调理矩阵在训练种子42进行单跑,并报告为单跑(附录C和D)。 我们不计算多种子和单运行配置之间的三角洲,因为这会使处理效果与特定的种子图混淆。

blocks.en: 4.2 Dataset
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据集

blocks.en: Main experiments use the four-language experimental subset described in Table 1 , comprising 12.78 hours of training audio across Twi (6.21h), Ga (2.48h), Ewe (2.47h), and Fante (1.62h). All splits are partitioned at the audio-file level to prevent overlap between training and evaluation.
blocks.zh: 主要实验使用表1所描述的四种语言实验子集,包括12.78小时的训练音频横跨Twi(6.21h),Ga(2.48h),Ewe(2.47h)和Fante(1.62h). 所有拆分在音频文件级别进行分割,以防止培训和评价之间的重叠.

blocks.en: We do not include a cascaded ASR → \rightarrow MT baseline, because no ASR system we are aware of supports Ga, Twi, Ewe, or Fante at acceptable accuracy. A cascade is therefore not realisable as a deployable system in this setting, which is characteristic of truly low-resource languages and motivates end-to-end speech translation.
blocks.zh: 我们不包含一个级联的 ASR ~\ 右旋 MT 基线,因为没有一个 ASR 系统 我们知道支持 Ga, Twi, Ewe, 或 Fante 以可接受的准确性。 因此,级联作为这种环境下的可部署系统是无法实现的,而这种系统是真正资源匮乏的语言的特征,并促使人们进行端到端的语音翻译。

blocks.en: 4.3 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 4.3 示范建筑

blocks.en: Figure 1 summarises the architecture. The top n = 4 n=4 Whisper encoder layers are fine-tuned while lower layers are frozen, selected to balance retention of pretrained acoustic structure with task-specific adaptation (see Appendix A for the depth selection analysis).
blocks.zh: 图1概述了建筑结构。 顶部n = 4n = 4 Whisper 编码器层在下层被冷冻的同时进行微调,选择以任务特定的调整来平衡预修声结构的保留(深度选择分析见附录A).

blocks.en: Figure 1: MGhana-ST inference graph. Input speech is processed by the Whisper feature extractor and encoder, projected to the decoder dimension, and decoded autoregressively to produce an English translation.
blocks.zh: 图1:MGANA-ST推论图。 输入语音由Whisper特性提取器和编码器处理,投射到解码器维度,并自动解码生成英文译文.

blocks.en: 4.4 Linguistic Relatedness Ordering
blocks.zh: 4.4 语言相关性

blocks.en: To compare different notions of relatedness within our language set, we consider URIEL syntactic similarity ( Littell et al., 2017 ) , geographic distance, and empirical cross-lingual transfer BLEU. Table 4 summarises these measures for all language pairs; the full pairwise transfer matrix is reported in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 为了比较我们语言组合中不同的关联性概念,我们认为URIEL的合成相似性(Littell等人,2017年),地理距离,以及经验性的跨语言转移BLEU. 表4汇总了针对所有语文对等的这些措施;附录C报告了完整的对等转移矩阵。

blocks.en: The measures do not fully agree. URIEL ranks Ga–Twi as the closest pair, whereas transfer BLEU identifies Twi–Fante as the strongest pair. Because transfer BLEU is derived directly from model behaviour on the target task, we use it as the primary ordering signal in our analysis. The gap between Twi–Fante (18.15 BLEU) and every other pair (0.13–1.23) is more than an order of magnitude, far larger than the seed variance measured elsewhere in this paper. The divergence among these measures suggests that general typological similarity does not necessarily correspond to task-specific transfer behaviour in low-resource speech translation.
blocks.zh: 这些措施并不完全一致。 URIEL将Ga–Twi列为最接近的对,而转移BLEU则将Twi–Fante列为最强的对. 由于转录BLEU直接来源于目标任务上的模型行为,我们用它作为我们分析中的主要命令信号. Twi–Fante(18.15 BLEU)与其他每对(0.13–1.23)之间的差距超过一个数量级,远大于本文其他部分所测量的种子差异. 这些措施之间的差异表明,一般类型学的相似性不一定与低资源语音翻译中针对特定任务的转移行为相对应.

blocks.en: Transfer BLEU should not be interpreted as reflecting linguistic relatedness alone. It may also be influenced by factors such as dataset size, speaker variability, recording conditions, and domain overlap. Notably, all Ewe data comes from a different source corpus than the other three varieties, so domain and channel similarity is partially confounded with linguistic relatedness. We therefore treat transfer BLEU as a task-specific empirical measure that aggregates linguistic, acoustic, and domain similarity.
blocks.zh: 转让BLEU不应被解释为仅反映语言相关性。 它也可能受到数据集大小,扬声器变异,记录条件,域重叠等因素的影响. 值得注意的是,Ewe的所有数据都来自与其他三个品种不同的源体,因此域和信道的相似性部分地与语言相关性相混淆. 因此,我们把转移BLEU视为一种针对具体任务的经验性措施,将语言、声学和域的相似性综合起来。

blocks.en: Table 4: Pairwise language relatedness across complementary measures. Transfer BLEU is the mean of the two directional zero-shot scores for each pair, single-run at seed 42. URIEL identifies Ga–Twi as closest, while transfer BLEU identifies Twi–Fante as the strongest transfer pair.
blocks.zh: 表4:各种补充措施的对等语言相关性。 转录BLEU是每对,单跑在42号种子的两个方向零射分数的平均值. URIEL将Ga–Twi识别为最接近,而转移BLEU则将Twi–Fante识别为最强的转移对.

blocks.en: 5 Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 结果和分析

blocks.en: 5.1 Does Multilingual Training Help?
blocks.zh: 5.1 多语种培训有帮助吗?

blocks.en: Table 5 reports monolingual (M1) and flat multilingual (M2) performance as means over three training seeds. The answer, at this data scale, is no: multilingual training does not reliably improve any of the four varieties, and substantially degrades two.
blocks.zh: 表5报告了单一语言(M1)和通用多语种(M2)的绩效,作为三个培训种子。 在这个数据尺度上,答案是否定的:多语种培训并不能可靠地改善这四个品种中的任何一种,并且大大地降解了两个品种.

blocks.en: Ga gains + 0.51 +0.51 BLEU and Twi + 0.06 +0.06 . Both are small relative to their monolingual seed standard deviations ( 1.63 1.63 and 2.20 2.20 respectively). We therefore treat both as null results rather than as gains.
blocks.zh: GA增益+0.51+0.51 BLEU和Twi+0.06+0.06 . 两者相对于其单一语言的种子标准偏差(分别为1.631.63和2.202.20)来说都很小. 因此,我们把两者都视为无效结果,而不是收益。

blocks.en: Ewe falls from 15.48 15.48 to 8.49 8.49 BLEU ( − 6.99 -6.99 ), and Fante from 47.61 47.61 to 42.50 42.50 ( − 5.11 -5.11 ). Both effects exceed twice the larger of the two conditions’ standard deviations and are corroborated by chrF ( − 8.64 -8.64 and − 3.89 -3.89 ). These are the substantive findings of this section.

The two varieties harmed are the typologically isolated one and the least-resourced one. Ewe is the only Gbe variety in the set, and additionally the only variety drawn from a different source corpus, so it shares neither family structure nor domain with the majority of the training pool. Fante, at 1.62 1.62 h, has the smallest training allocation of the four, roughly a quarter of Twi’s 6.21 6.21 h. Twi, the largest, is unaffected. This is the pattern expected if joint training under fixed capacity reallocates representational resources toward the better-represented and better-connected varieties.
blocks.zh: 受损害的两种品种是分类隔离的一种,也是资源最少的一种。 Ewe是该集中唯一一种Gbe品种,另外也是从不同来源体中抽取的唯一品种,因此它既不共享家庭结构,也不与大多数培训人才共享领域. Fante在1.621.62 h时拥有四人中最小的训练分配,大约是Twi的6.21 6.21 h的四分之一. 最大的Twi没有受到影响. 如果在固定能力下进行联合培训,将代表资源重新分配给代表性更高、联系更紧密的品种,这就是预期的模式。

Bold marks deltas whose magnitude exceeds twice the larger of the two standard deviations. Corpus-level M2 BLEU is 22.50 ± 0.27 22.50\pm 0.27 . Per-seed values are in Appendix F .

blocks.en: 5.2 Seed Variance and the Cost of Single-Run Reporting
blocks.zh: 5.2 种子差异和单一运行报告费用

blocks.en: The seed standard deviations in Table 5 are themselves informative, and they differ between configurations in a way that matters for how such comparisons are reported.
blocks.zh: 表5中的种子标准偏差本身是信息性的,而且不同配置的差异对于如何报告这种比较很重要。

blocks.en: For Ga and Twi, the monolingual models are markedly less stable than the multilingual ones: ± 1.63 \pm 1.63 versus ± 0.35 \pm 0.35 BLEU for Ga, and ± 2.20 \pm 2.20 versus ± 0.07 \pm 0.07 for Twi. For Ewe and Fante the ordering reverses ( ± 0.56 \pm 0.56 versus ± 1.15 \pm 1.15 , and ± 0.79 \pm 0.79 versus ± 1.43 \pm 1.43 ). The multilingual model sees two to eight times as much training audio per epoch as any single monolingual model, which plausibly stabilises Ga and Twi. That the two degraded varieties are also the ones whose multilingual runs vary most is consistent with their performance depending on how shared capacity is allocated in each run, although we have not tested this directly.
blocks.zh: 对于Ga和Twi,单语模式明显不如多语模式稳定:±1.63\pm 1.63对±0.35\pm0.35 BLEU对Ga;±2.20\pm 2.20对±0.07\pm 0.07对Twi。对于Ewe和Fante,命令反转(±0.56\pm 0.56对±1.15\pm 1.15,0.79对±1.43\pm 1.43)。 多语种模式认为每个时代的训练音频是任何单一语言模式的2到8倍,这在逻辑上稳定了Ga和Twi. 两种退化的品种也是其多语种分布差异最大的品种,这与它们的表现是一致的,这取决于在每次运行中如何分配共同的能力,尽管我们没有直接测试这一点。

blocks.en: This matters methodologically. Where the monolingual condition is the noisier one, a single-run M1–M2 comparison pairs a noisy monolingual number with a stable multilingual one, so the sign of the reported delta is largely determined by where the monolingual draw happens to fall. An earlier single-run version of this analysis, at training seed 42, reported + 2.95 +2.95 (Ga), + 1.68 +1.68 (Twi), − 4.46 -4.46 (Ewe), and + 0.46 +0.46 (Fante), that is, three gains and one loss. Under replication, all three apparent gains disappear, and Fante’s reverses sign.
blocks.zh: 这在方法上很重要。 当单语状态是噪声状态时,单运行的M1-M2对比将吵闹的单语数与稳定的多语种数对齐,因此所报道的三角洲的标志很大程度上是由单语画的碰巧落地决定的. 早先的单运行版本本分析在训练种子42上报告了+2.95+2.95(Ga),+1.68+1.68(Twi),−4.46-46(Ewe),+0.46+0.46(Fante),即3个增益和1个损失. 在复制中,所有三个明显的收益都消失了,方德的反向标志也消失了.

blocks.en: We do not believe this failure mode is specific to our setup. Low-resource multilingual comparisons are often reported from a single run, and wherever monolingual baselines trained on a few hours of audio are less stable than the pooled model, as they are for Ga and Twi here, single-run reporting can produce apparent positive transfer from seed variation alone. Our results suggest that comparisons at this data scale should report seed variance for both conditions as a matter of course.
blocks.zh: 我们并不认为这种失败模式是针对我们的设定的。 低资源多语种比较经常从一次运行中报告,只要在几小时音频上培训的单一语言基线比集合模式不稳定,就如同这里的Ga和Twi一样,单运行报告单从种子变异中可以产生明显的正转移. 我们的结果表明,在这个数据尺度上的比较应报告这两种情况的种子差异。

blocks.en: 5.3 Separating Family from Domain
blocks.zh: 5.3 家庭与地区分离

blocks.en: Because all Ewe data is drawn from UGSpeechData while Ga, Twi, and Fante come entirely from the Financial Inclusion Speech Dataset, the Ewe degradation admits two explanations: family distance (Gbe vs. Akan) and domain mismatch. Ga provides a partial control, since it shares corpus provenance with Twi and Fante but does not share their language family. If domain similarity alone drove transfer, Ga should transfer strongly to Twi and Fante; instead Ga → \rightarrow Twi and Ga → \rightarrow Fante reach only 0.98 and 1.48 BLEU (Table 8 , Appendix C ), far below Twi → \rightarrow Fante and Fante → \rightarrow Twi (23.36 and 12.94). Domain overlap alone is therefore not sufficient to generate transfer in this dataset.
blocks.zh: 因为所有 Ewe数据来自UGSpeechData,而Ga,Twi,和Fante完全来自金融普惠演讲数据集,Ewe降解承认两个解释:家庭距离(Gbe vs. Akan)和域名不匹配. Ga提供部分控制,因为它与Twi和Fante分享书本来源,但不分享他们的语言家族. 如果仅是域的相似性驱动传输,Ga就应该强力转移给Twi和Fante;相反,Ga →\右翼Twi和Ga →\右翼Fante只达到0.98和1.48BLEU(表8,附录C),远远低于Twi →\右翼Fante和Fante →\右翼Twi(23.36和12.94)。 因此,仅靠域重叠不足以在此数据集中生成传输.

blocks.en: 5.4 Effect of Linguistic Relatedness
blocks.zh: 5.4 语言相关性的影响

blocks.en: To examine the role of linguistic relatedness, we compare multilingual outcomes with pairwise relatedness measures and cross-lingual transfer scores. The strongest zero-shot transfer is observed between Twi and Fante, which is consistent with their closer linguistic relationship and shared corpus provenance. By contrast, language pairs involving Ewe and Ga show substantially weaker transfer.
blocks.zh: 为了审查语言相关性的作用,我们比较了多语种结果与对等相关性计量和跨语言转录分数. 在Twi和Fante之间观察到最强的零射转机,这与他们更紧密的语言关系和共享的命案来源是一致的. 与此相反,涉及Ewe和Ga的对语言的转移明显较弱。

blocks.en: The multi-seed results qualify how this should be read. Strong pairwise transfer between Twi and Fante does not translate into Fante benefiting from joint training; Fante is one of the two varieties that degrades. High measured transfer therefore predicts that a language can draw on a related pool, not that it will be allocated capacity within it. Transfer BLEU remains the more direct task-specific indicator of which pairs interact in this setting, but it is not by itself a predictor of which languages gain under joint training.
blocks.zh: 多种子结果对如何理解这一点具有限定性。 Twi和Fante之间的强对接转不会转化为Fante受益于联合训练;Fante是降解的两个品种之一. 因此,高计量的转移预测一种语言可以借鉴相关的集合,而不是在其中分配能力。 转移BLEU仍然是比较直接的具体任务指标,其中的对子在此环境下相互作用,但是它本身并不是预测在联合培训下获得哪些语言的预测器.

blocks.en: These comparisons suggest that, in our setting, task-specific transfer measurements are more informative than general typological similarity for anticipating which languages interact.
blocks.zh: 这些比较表明,在我们的背景中,针对特定任务的转移测量比一般类型学的相似性更能预测哪些语言相互作用。

blocks.en: 5.5 Target-Side Overlap and Reference Diversity
blocks.zh: 5.5 目标重叠和参考多样性

blocks.en: Because MGhana-ST is drawn from narrow-domain source corpora, English reference translations repeat across examples, which inflates BLEU without reflecting translation capability. Cross-language score comparisons are not like-for-like. Fante’s high monolingual score ( 47.61 47.61 BLEU from 1.62h of training audio) is likely influenced by reference repetition rather than indicating that Fante is an easier language: only 323 distinct English strings cover its 524 test utterances. Ewe sits at the opposite extreme, with 1.5% target overlap and 3.31 s mean duration, so its lower absolute BLEU ( 15.48 15.48 ) reflects a harder generation task. Absolute BLEU should therefore not be compared across the four varieties. This does not affect the within-language comparisons that carry our main findings: the M1–M2 contrast holds the test set fixed for each language, so the deltas are measured against each variety’s own baseline.
blocks.zh: 由于MGANA-ST来自狭义域源代码corpora,英文参考翻译重复了各种实例,这些实例夸大了BLEU而不反映翻译能力. 跨语言的分数比较并不像. Fante的高单语分数(培训音频1.62h的47.6147.61BLEU)很可能受到参考重复的影响,而不是表明Fante是一个比较容易的语言:只有323个独特的英语字符串覆盖了它的524个测试语音. Ewe坐落在相反的极端,目标重叠1.5%,平均持续时间为3.31,因此其较低的绝对BLEU(15.48 15.48 )反映了更难的一代任务. 因此,不应对这四个品种的绝对低浓铀进行比较。 这不影响包含我们主要结论的语言内部比较:M1-M2对比为每种语言设置了固定的测试装置,因此三角洲是按每种物种自己的基线测量的。

blocks.en: Further details on prompt reuse and domain overlap appear in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 关于迅速再利用和域重叠的进一步详情见附录E。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Our results support four broader points about low-resource multilingual speech translation.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果支持关于低资源多语种语言翻译的四点更广泛的观点。

blocks.en: First, multilingual training should not be assumed to provide benefits at all at this data scale. In MGhana-ST, joint training left two varieties unchanged and substantially degraded the other two. Practitioners building for these varieties at comparable data volumes should treat monolingual training as the default and multilingual training as a hypothesis requiring per-language validation.
blocks.zh: 首先,不应假定多语种培训在这一数据规模上提供任何好处。 在MGANA-ST,联合培训使两个品种保持不变,使另外两个品种严重退化。 以可比数据量建造这些品种的从业者应将单一语言培训视为缺省性培训,将多语言培训视为需要每种语言验证的假说。

blocks.en: Second, the varieties that degrade share identifiable characteristics. The typologically isolated variety and the least-resourced variety degraded, while Twi, the best-resourced variety, did not. Notably, Fante degraded despite belonging to the strongest transfer pair in the set, indicating that relatedness to the training pool does not protect a language whose share of that pool is small.
blocks.zh: 第二,降解的品种具有可识别的特点。 类型上孤立的品种和资源最少的品种退化,而资源最丰富的品种Twi则没有退化. 值得注意的是,Fante尽管属于一组中最强的转会组合,但退化表明,与训练池的关联性并不能保护该组合中份额较小的语言。

blocks.en: Third, typology-based similarity and task-specific transfer behaviour are not interchangeable. Empirical cross-lingual transfer identifies which language pairs interact more accurately than URIEL similarity does, yet it does not predict which languages benefit under joint training.
blocks.zh: 第三,基于类型相似性和针对具体任务的转移行为不可互换。 经验性跨语言转移识别出哪些语言对子比URIEL相似性更精确地相互作用,然而它却无法预测哪些语言在联合培训下受益.

blocks.en: Fourth, and methodologically, the reliability of results in this regime is itself at stake. Our own earlier single-run analysis reported the opposite headline conclusion. For the two varieties on which that analysis showed its largest gains, Ga and Twi, the monolingual models were roughly five to thirty times less stable across seeds than the multilingual model. Our results suggest that multi-seed reporting for both conditions should be considered standard practice for sub-twenty-hour multilingual comparisons.
blocks.zh: 第四,从方法上讲,该制度结果的可靠性本身就岌岌可危。 我们自己早先的单运行分析报告得出了相反的头条结论. 对于这一分析显示其最大收益的两个品种Ga和Twi,单一语言模型的种子稳定性大约是多语言模型的五至三十倍。 我们的结果表明,两个条件的多种子报告应被视为20小时以下多种语文比较的标准做法。

blocks.en: These observations arise from experiments on MGhana-ST using Whisper-small under the training configurations considered here, and should be interpreted as empirical findings within this experimental setting rather than universal properties of multilingual speech translation.
blocks.zh: 这些意见产生于在本文中考虑的培训结构下使用Whisper-small对MGhana-ST的实验,应当被解释为这种试验背景下的经验性结论,而不是多语种语音翻译的普遍性质。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The experimental subset contains only about 16.1 hours of paired speech and translation data. Twi accounts for the largest share (6.21h of 12.78h of training audio), while Fante is the least represented at 1.62 hours. Model comparisons are therefore sensitive to data composition.
blocks.zh: 实验子集仅包含约16.1小时的对口和翻译数据. Twi在12.78h的训练音频中占有最大份额(6.21h),而Fante在1.62小时中代表最少. 因此,模型比较对数据组成很敏感。

blocks.en: As reported in Section 3.1 , 12.6% of annotated segments reference audio not present in our working copy (39.9% for Ewe and 30.4% for Fante). We have not established whether these files are absent upstream or only locally, nor whether their absence correlates with speaker, recording session, or collection batch. This does not compromise the within-language M1–M2 contrasts, since all configurations train and evaluate on identical data, but it does limit what the Ewe and Fante results can be said to represent about those varieties in general.
blocks.zh: 如第3.1节所述,12.6%的附加说明部分的音频在我们的工作副本中没有(Ewe为39.9%,Fante为30.4%)。 我们尚未确定这些档案是否在上游或仅在当地没有,也没有确定它们是否与发言者、录音会议或收集批次有关。 这并不影响语言内部的M1-M2对比,因为所有的配置都会在相同的数据上进行训练和评价,但它确实限制了Ewe和Fante的结果可以说能代表这些品种的总体情况。

blocks.en: The auxiliary conditioning experiments and the transfer matrix are single-run. Given seed standard deviations of up to 2.20 BLEU, these should be treated as exploratory. Extending multi-seed coverage to all configurations is a priority for future work.
blocks.zh: 辅助调节实验和转移矩阵为单运行. 鉴于种子标准偏差可达2.20BLEU,应将其视为探索性差。 将多种子覆盖扩大到所有配置是未来工作的优先事项。

blocks.en: All runs share a single data partition. Our error bars therefore capture training variance only. Variance across data partitions is not measured.
blocks.zh: 所有运行都共享一个数据分区. 因此,我们的错误栏只记录训练差异。 数据分区之间的差异没有计量。

blocks.en: MGhana-ST aggregates two source corpora that differ in domain, recording channel, speaking style, and utterance duration, unevenly distributed across varieties. Language identity is therefore partially confounded with acoustic and domain characteristics. We use Ga as a partial control to bound this effect, but a clean separation would require matched-domain data for all four varieties.
blocks.zh: MGhana-ST汇总了两个来源公司,在域、录音频道、演讲风格和语音时间方面各不相同,在各品种之间分布不均。 因此,语言特征部分与声学和域特征相混淆. 我们用Ga作为部分控制来约束这种效果,但是干净的分离需要所有四个品种的匹配域数据.

blocks.en: MGhana-ST covers four varieties from one region of Ghana and should not be taken to represent Ghanaian languages broadly. Domain coverage is narrow, dominated by financial-technology scenarios for three varieties. Dialectal coverage within Twi is not characterised (Akuapem and Asante are merged). Speaker demographic distributions for the subset are not reported.
blocks.zh: MGhana-ST涵盖来自加纳一个地区的四个品种,不应被视为广泛代表加纳语言。 域范围狭窄,以三个品种的金融技术设想为主. Twi内部的糖尿病覆盖率没有特征化(Akuapem和Asante合并). 该子集的议长人口分布没有报告。

blocks.en: The encoder fine-tuning depth was chosen from a single-run sweep scored on the Ga test split of a preliminary partition (Appendix A ). The selected depth is held fixed across all configurations, so it does not favour M1 or M2, but it is not a held-out choice.
blocks.zh: 编码器的微调深度是从一个初步分区(Appendix A )的Ga测试分片(Ga)上的单跑扫射得分中选择的. 在所有配置中,选定的深度被固定,所以它不赞成M1或M2,但它不是一个被搁置的选择.

blocks.en: Three of the four varieties consist largely of single words and short phrases (mean duration 1.33–1.90 s), and their English references repeat substantially. MGhana-ST does not support conclusions about sentence-level speech translation, and absolute BLEU is not comparable across its four varieties.
blocks.zh: 这四个品种中有三个主要由单词和短句组成(平均持续时间1.33-1.90秒),它们的英文参考大量重复。 MGhana-ST不支持关于句子级语音翻译的结论,绝对的BLEU在其四个品种中并不具有可比性.

blocks.en: Training runs are not bitwise deterministic, so individual runs cannot be reproduced exactly even at a fixed seed. The reported means and standard deviations are the reproducible quantities.
blocks.zh: 训练跑不是用位元决定的,所以即使是在固定的种子中也不能完全复制个人跑. 所报告的手段和标准偏差是可复制的数量。

blocks.zh: 使用人工智能助理

blocks.en: AI assistants were used during the preparation of this paper for coding support, editorial refinement, and language editing. They were not used to generate experimental results, analyses, or conclusions, all of which are the authors’ own.
blocks.zh: 在编写本文件期间,使用AI助手进行编码支持、编辑改进和语言编辑。 它们没有被用来产生实验结果、分析或结论,所有这一切都是作者自己的。

blocks.en: These results are exploratory and single-run at seed 42. Because Section 5.2 establishes that single-run differences at this data scale can exceed the effects of interest, we report them as directional evidence only. All comparisons are made against the single-run M2 baseline at seed 42 (Ga 37.71, Twi 19.59, Ewe 9.60, Fante 46.19; corpus 23.72).
blocks.zh: 这些结果都是探索性的,在42号种子进行单跑. 因为第5.2节规定,在这个数据尺度上的单运行差异可以超过利益的影响,所以我们只将其报告为方向性证据. 所有与种子42的单跑M2基线(Ga 37.71、Twi 19.59、Ewe 9.60、Fante 46.19;ect 23.72)进行比较。

blocks.en: We evaluate two auxiliary objectives. M3 applies Domain-Adversarial Training (DANN) with gradient reversal to encourage language-invariant encoder representations ( λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 ). M4 applies Language Identification (LID) supervision to encourage language-discriminative representations ( α = 0.1 \alpha=0.1 in Equation 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们评价两个辅助目标。 M3应用了具有梯度反转的DANN(Domain-Adversarial Training(DANN))来鼓励语言不变量编码器表示(QQ=0.1\lambda=0.1). M4应用语言识别(LID)监督,鼓励语言歧视表达(α=0.1\alpha=0.1在方程式1 ).

blocks.en: DANN improves Ewe substantially, from 9.60 to 13.23 BLEU ( + 3.63 +3.63 ). However, Fante declines by 4.57 BLEU and Twi by 0.83, while Ga is unchanged. Corpus-level BLEU is slightly below M2, so DANN reallocates performance rather than improving it uniformly.
blocks.zh: DANN 改进 Ewe大幅下降,从9.60降至13.23BLEU(+3.63+3.63),但Fante下降4.57BLEU和Twi下降0.83,而Ga则保持不变. 公司级的BLEU略低于M2,因此DANN重新调配性能而不是统一改进.

blocks.en:
LID conditioning underperforms M2 for all four languages (Ga − 1.59 -1.59 , Fante − 1.76 -1.76 , Ewe − 0.64 -0.64 , Twi − 0.51 -0.51 ), with corpus BLEU 0.76 below M2. Encouraging the encoder to represent language identity more sharply does not mitigate interference at this seed.
We have not verified that either objective changes what the encoder represents; probing the encoder states for language identity, in the manner of prior probing work on distributed representations ( Acquaye et al., 2023 ) , would test this directly.
blocks.zh:
用于所有四种语言的 LID 配置失败 M2 (Ga−1.59-1.59,Fante−1.76-1.76,Ewe−0.64-0.64,Twi−0.51-0.51),实体BLEU 0.76低于M2. 鼓励编码器更尖锐地代表语言身份并不能减轻对这一种子的干扰.
我们尚未证实,这两个目标都改变编码器所代表的内容;通过事先对分布式表示(Acquaye等人,2023年)的探测工作,对编码器语言特性进行测试,将直接检验这一点。

blocks.en: Appendix E Target-Side Overlap and Prompt Reuse
blocks.zh: 附录E 目标重叠和迅速重新使用

blocks.en: Reference repetition has two consequences. First, Fante reference repetition is a direct consequence of the collection protocol: speakers of a given dialect recorded a shared list of approximately 130 prompt sentences. Because our splits are constructed at the audio-file level, a prompt sentence recorded by one speaker may appear in training while the same sentence recorded by another appears in test. Scores on Ga, Twi, and Fante reflect a setting in which the space of target sentences is small and partially shared across splits, and should be read as performance on a closed prompt inventory. Ewe, drawn from image-description recordings, is not subject to this and shows correspondingly low reference repetition (1.5%).
blocks.zh: 重复引用有两个后果。 首先,Fante的参考重复是收集协议的直接后果:某一方言的演讲者记录了大约130个快速句子的共享列表. 因为我们的分词是在音频文件级别上构建的,一个发言者记录的即时句可能会出现在训练中,而另一个发言者记录的相同句子则出现在测试中. 在Ga,Twi,和Fante上的分数反映了一个设定,即目标句子的空间很小,并部分分数共享,应读作在封闭的即时盘点上的性能. 从图像描述录音中抽取的Ewe不受此限制,并显示相应的低参考重复(1.5%).

blocks.en: Second, reference repetition raises a natural objection to using transfer BLEU as a relatedness signal (Section 4.4 ): if Twi and Fante share a domain and a stock of high-frequency English formulae, strong Twi–Fante transfer might reflect a shared phrase inventory. Ga shares the same source corpus and domain as Twi and Fante, with comparable reference repetition (27.2% for Ga against 27.4% for Twi), yet Ga–Twi transfer is negligible (0.98 and 0.38 BLEU). Domain overlap and reference repetition are thus not sufficient to generate transfer; the Akan relationship shared by Twi and Fante is what distinguishes the two cases.
blocks.zh: 第二,引用重复自然会反对使用转移BLEU作为关联性信号(第4.4节):如果Twi和Fante共享一个域和大量高频英语公式,强大的Twi–Fante传输可能会反映一个共享的短语目录. Ga与Twi和Fante拥有相同的来源和域名,可比较的参考重复(Ga为27.2%,Twi为27.4%),然而Ga-Twi的转移可忽略不计(0.98和0.38 BLEU)。 因此,域重叠和引用重复不足以生成传输;Twi和Fante共享的Akan关系是这两个案例的区别.
